thread:
alice: quick heads-up — seeing sustained KV resident-set growth on a qwen-mqa long-run when rope_scale != 1.0. repro on 64k seqs, pages not being reused as expected.
perf-bot: [alert] 1923456000: kv-residency-increase on bench-qwen-mqa-longrun
ben: any idea if this is the familiar fragmentation pattern or something new? did we change kernels recently?
cara: no kernel changes. last deploy changed batching heuristic (prefer_small_batches=true) which modifies prefetch timing. worth checking.
alice: heap snapshot shows a lot of small orphaned page blocks where adjacent seq ranges have different rope metadata.
alice: page map excerpt:
```
page 0x7f9a..: seq_start=4096 seq_end=8192 rope_scale=1.25 flags=MQA_PARTIAL reused=false
page 0x7f9b..: seq_start=8192 seq_end=12288 rope_scale=1.0 flags=MQA_FULL reused=true
```
ben: if allocations and later accesses compute different page signatures (rope math differences) reuse will fail. qwen tokenization can trigger mixed rope handling across layers.
dinesh: also possible GQA/MQA dimensional changes when we flip attention kernels; note we added kernel selection on token_len buckets recently. that might affect the page keying shape.
cara: kernel selector introduced a fallback for odd seq lengths that toggles rope_wrap handling. that alters what we use as page signature.
alice: repro steps I used:
1) bench long-context (64k) with qwen-mqa quant config
2) set rope_scale=1.25 in model cfg
3) spray concurrent tiny requests (~8 tokens) for 30m
observed ~+1.6GB mem over 30m, eviction/GC didn't free those pages.
ben: were pages pinned? any eviction traces?
alice: eviction ran but saw a refcount race:
```
[evict] page 0x7f9a.. queued
[kv] refdec page 0x7f9a.. deferred by kernel-switch
[bg-cleaner] saw page but flag REUSE_SAFE=false -> skip
```
cara: batching heuristic may worsen churn: prefer_small_batches delays consolidation and increases transient allocs before coalescing.
dinesh: I'll add allocator instrumentation to log page signatures (model, rope_scale, kernel_id, seq_range) on alloc/free. put it behind a debug flag for staging.
alice: please also add a metric for kernel_id in page_map so we can count mismatches.
ben: hypothesis: kernel_selector swaps kernel mid-stream and the page_id computation uses kernel-specific rope handling. subsequent accesses use a different kernel and mismatch. eviction sees low reuse and pages linger due to refcount timing.
cara: short-term mitigation: on kernel switch canonicalize page signatures to a kernel-agnostic form (normalize rope_scale or store canonical rope hash).
dinesh: alternative: limit kernel switches to batch boundaries and flush pending allocs to allow reuse.
alice: quick perf from the local patch that normalizes signatures:
- baseline: throughput 340 TPS, mem +1.6GB over 30m
- with signature-normalize: throughput 332 TPS, mem stable, reuse_rate +18%
ben: small throughput hit but memory stability wins. need CI reproducer.
cara: check mistral too 12 — mistral uses rope_scale ~0.98 with GQA fallback; we might see different mismatch shapes.
alice: ran a quick mistral pass: smaller total growth but more fragmentation (many <4KB orphan pages). qwen-mqa leaves larger orphan chunks.
dinesh: plan:
- add allocator logging (kernel_id + page_sig) behind debug flag; perf-bot can enable on a targeted pool
- land canonicalization patch (PR from me)
- add CI long-context reproducer that hits this pattern
- run 24h staging monitor
ben: add metric page_mismatch_count tied to kernel_switch events and a grafana panel for it.
cara: i'll add dashboard + alert (alert when mismatch_count > 50/hr).
alice: also consider reverting prefer_small_batches or making it adaptive based on reuse_hit_rate.
dinesh: will gate batching: if reuse_hit_rate < 0.6 then prefer_larger_batches=true.
ben: owners: dinesh - allocator PR, cara - dashboard/alert, alice - reproducer/test harness.
alice: i'll push the repro script to the longrun bench repo and post link when ready.
cara: tagging @oncall FYI in case staging spikes :eyes:
